scenes.title: A CHART CAN LOOK RIGHT
scenes.narration: A chart can look perfect and still be wrong.

scenes.title: CHECK THE TIMESTAMP
scenes.narration: Start with the timestamp. Is the data fresh?

scenes.title: LOOK FOR MISSING DATA
scenes.narration: Check for missing bars and gaps.

scenes.title: KNOW YOUR SOURCE
scenes.narration: Know what your data source actually covers.

scenes.title: NO TRUST. NO TRADE.
scenes.narration: If the information is stale, incomplete, or unclear, stop. No reliable data means no trade.

A clean-looking chart is not proof of clean data.

Check the timestamp. Look for missing bars. Understand what your data source actually covers. When the information is stale or incomplete, step aside.
